summary: Iteration 6: tested the Remote Signing module ('Semnare la distanță') end to end on the backend and frontend, plus the client operator select and regressions. Backend: the new tests/test_remote_signing.py has 11 tests and all pass. They cover create (one item per position x signer, only the token hash is stored, opis status becomes 'necesită semnătură'), 400 validation, 404 for an unknown position, listing by dossier_id and client_name, /sent -> 'Link trimis', the public info call -> 'Deschis', document PDF and page PNGs (the document's SHA-256 matches the stored one), the 404 for an out-of-range page, a real OTP email to delivered@resend.dev (provider answered 202) with a 429 on the immediate resend (45s cooldown), a wrong code -> 400 'Cod incorect' with history 'Cod greșit', and a successful sign using an OTP planted in Mongo. Signing makes the token return 404, and the signed PDF has the original pages plus one evidence page per signer; the last page is 'FIȘĂ DE EVIDENȚĂ A SEMNĂRII ELECTRONICE'. In a group of 2 signers the file is attached to the opis position (status 'atașat') and the 'Semnat electronic' document is created only after both have signed. Refuse -> 'Refuzat', token invalid, and new-link is blocked. New-link -> old token 404, history kept. An expires_at in the past -> 'Expirat', pages 0, OTP 410. Revoke -> 'Expirat', revoked true, token 404. Calls without auth -> 401/403. The previous regression suite passes (50 passed, 1 skipped). Frontend: the prosumator Semnături section creates a link (sign-link-url, copy/WhatsApp/SMS/mailto); copy changes the status to 'Link trimis'. The public page at 390x844 renders the page images; the submit button stays disabled until name, 6-digit code, signature and intent are all present; signing ends at sign-done and a reload shows sign-error. The OTP button works and the cooldown message appears. Refuse works. An expired link shows sign-closed. /semnare lists all 4 statuses with 'PDF semnat' download (200), new-link, revoke and history. The client edit form shows the Semnături list, and the operator select shows the official names and keeps the legacy value 'DEER — Transilvania Nord'. 2 real OTP emails were sent in total. All TEST data was cleaned up, including the old 'TESTSIGN Ion' request; ZOLTAN opis is back to {} and the sign_requests collection is empty.

minor.issue: A non-numeric expires_days such as 'abc' gives a 500, because float() is called unguarded (the same applies to /new-link). expires_days=0 silently becomes 7 because of `or 7`, and 0.5 is accepted, although the spec says 1-90. Validate as an integer in 1..90 and return 400.

There is no atomic guard. Two concurrent sign calls with the same valid OTP could both pass, because the check happens before update_one. Use find_one_and_update with a filter on status in SIGN_ACTIVE and token_hash.
Neither otp_sends nor otp_last is reset. After 5 sends, a new link can never get an OTP (it returns 429 for good).

ui_bugs.issue: After a link is revoked (status Expirat/revoked), the LinkBox with the old URL and its Copy/WhatsApp/SMS/E-mail buttons stays visible, because the token is still in the tokens state and `closed` only covers Semnat/Refuzat. The operator could send a dead link. Hide the LinkBox when status is Expirat or revoked, or remove the token on revoke.

The images use loading='lazy' and have no reserved height, so the layout shifts as pages load. The sign-pad moved about 70px mid-test and strokes landed outside the pad. A real user starting to sign before the pages finish loading could hit the same problem. Add an aspect-ratio (for example 210/297) or a min-height to the images.

A link that has already been signed or refused shows 'Link invalid sau revocat' (404, because token_hash is nulled) instead of a friendlier 'already signed' message. sign-closed only ever appears for expired links.

integration_issues.issue: wa.me uses the raw phone digits, for example 0722111222. WhatsApp needs the international format (40722111222), so local Romanian numbers starting with 0 will not open the right chat.

issues: Page images are rendered at 110 dpi and scaled to about 340px wide, so the text is very small on a phone. Consider a tap-to-zoom option or a higher dpi.
The second operator select (around line 284) still uses the old short names ('DEER — Transilvania Nord', 'Rețele Electrice România'). These do not match the new official list used in the client form.

action_items: Validate expires_days as an integer in 1..90 and return 400 instead of 500 for bad input (in both create and new-link).
Hide the LinkBox after a link is revoked or expired in SignRequests.jsx.
Make the sign update atomic (find_one_and_update with a status/token filter).
Reset otp_sends and otp_last when a new link is generated.
Normalise the WhatsApp phone number to international format (0xxxxxxxxx -> 40xxxxxxxxx).
Reserve the image aspect-ratio on SignPage to avoid layout shift.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1018 lines. Move the Semnare la distanță section into its own module (sign.py).
pub_sign_info opens the whole PDF with pymupdf just to count pages, and the page endpoint re-renders on every request. Cache the page count or the rendered PNGs.
sign_file with kind != 'signed' returns the original PDF; this is fine, but kind is not validated.
Expiry comparison uses ISO strings. It works because the format is always +00:00, but it is fragile.
seed_data_creation: None left behind. TEST sign_requests, 'Semnat electronic' documents and opis keys (afm, pif, reglaj, imputernicire, schema, priza, notificare) on ZOLTAN were removed. The old TESTSIGN Ion request was deleted, so the token in /app/memory/.signtok is now invalid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest tests/test_remote_signing.py -n 0. It sends 1 real OTP to delivered@resend.dev, plants OTPs directly in Mongo, and cleans up in a fixture teardown. On the public sign page, wait for the images to load before drawing on sign-pad (layout shift).
